questions.markdown: Analyze and design a sequential circuit based on the Mealy model that uses D flip-flops to detect the sequence "0101". The circuit should produce an active high output only when the sequence is detected and maintain an active low output at all other times. Ensure that the design allows overlapping of the sequence, meaning that part of one detected sequence can serve as the beginning of the next.
Illustrate and explain the Three-Bus oriented Register ALU architecture and outline the contrasting features with that of Two-Bus oriented Register ALU architecture.

Using your understanding of asynchronous counters and SR - flip flops, design a frequency divider circuit that reduces the system clock frequency by a factor of 1/6. Incorporate the appropriate logic gates to achieve the desired frequency division.

Design a combinational circuit using 4-bit adder and external gates to add two 4-bit numbers $A$ and $B$.

If $C < 3$, $B = 2C$,

if $C$ is a multiple of 3, $B = C+4$,

for all the remaining cases, $B = C$

Where, $C$ is a 3-bit binary number.
Design a 4X4 combinational shifter using MUX and tristate buffer.
Design G flip flop according to the Table Q2C using NOR latch.

questions.markdown: Perform division of $(1100)_2$ by $(101)_2$ using non-restoring division algorithm, indicating all the steps.
Design 2-bit X 2-bit binary multiplier using 3 to 8 decoder with active low output and minimum external gates.
Design a 2 - bit magnitude comparator using basic gates.
Design a 4-bit synchronous binary counter. Draw the circuit using JK flip-flops and explain how the flip-flops are connected to count in binary from 0000 to 1111 in synchronization with the clock.
Design a 3-bit asynchronous counter using JK flip flops. Provide the circuit diagram and explain how the state transitions occur with clock inputs.
D For a function defined by minterms 1, 3, 7, 11, and 15, and don't-cares at 0, 2, 4, and 5, fill the K-map and minimize the function.

questions.markdown: Design a 3-bit binary-to-Gray code converter using only basic gates (AND, OR, NOT). Provide the truth table and logic circuit for the conversion.
Show how to create an 8-to-1 multiplexer by combining two 4-to-1 multiplexers and an additional 2-to-1 multiplexer
Compare I/O mapped and memory-mapped I/O in terms of address space usage, speed, and complexity. Why might one be chosen over the other in a particular system design?
